personality: 4 Tactile / Playful with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces (Aurora Workspace Fusion)
personality_one_liner: A bright, airy, and tactile glassmorphism environment that transforms heavy academic research into an approachable, frictionless flow using soft pastel auroras and layered depth.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around glass cards. Keep minimum 16pt margin between screen edges and cards. Safe area must be respected at screen root.

do's: Use backdrop blur (expo-blur) heavily on surfaceSecondary cards with a rgba(255,255,255,0.7) tint.
Pin a frosted tab bar and sticky frosted header over the scrolling aurora background.
Apply a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.4) border to all glass cards to define their edges.
Ensure text on glass uses onSurface (#111827) for high contrast.
dont's: Do not blur form inputs or primary text regions.
Do not use dark shadows on glass; use a very soft, diffused shadow (shadow tier 2).
Do not stack more than two blur surfaces over each other.

screens.name: Landing_Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app, highlight research flow, and prompt login/registration.
screens.layout: Full-bleed fixed `aurora_background_1`. Large center Mascot (`stella_mascot`), large display title (Inter, max weight 500), brief subtitle. Primary CTA 'Get Started' pinned at the bottom in a frosted glass container above the safe area.

screens.name: Auth (Login / Register)

states.error: Frosted red error banner at the top

screens.layout: Fixed aurora background. Single large frosted `surfaceSecondary` card in the center containing the form. Labels above inputs. Inputs have solid `surfaceTertiary` backgrounds for contrast. Sticky submit button at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Dashboard_Home
screens.purpose: High-level overview of user's research activity, mastery, and milestones.

states.empty: Stella mascot + 'Start your first research project' primary CTA
states.error: Error message with 'Retry' button inside a frosted card

screens.layout: Sticky frosted header with greeting. Scrolling body over aurora background. Top section: Activity line chart (smooth curves). Middle section: 2-column grid of KPI cards (Stats, delta badges). Bottom: Topic Mastery (radial rings) and Milestone Timeline. FAB at bottom right for 'New Project'.

screens.name: Projects_List
screens.purpose: Workspace directory of all research projects.
screens.layout: List of horizontal frosted cards. Each card displays project title, last edited date, and status pill (`brandTertiary`). Floating Action Button for 'New Project' pinned above the frosted tab bar.

screens.name: New_Project_Modal
screens.purpose: Capture initial domain and keywords to kick off Topic Discovery.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet (full-screen capability) with frosted glass header. Form inputs for Domain and Keywords. Sticky 'Generate Topics' primary button at bottom.

screens.name: Topic_Generator
screens.purpose: Display AI-generated topics with scores so the user can select one.

states.loading: Stella mascot animated + 'AI is discovering topics...'

screens.layout: Horizontal snap carousel of tall frosted cards. Each card contains the Topic Title, Novelty Score (radial ring), Difficulty Score (pill), and suggested datasets. Sticky 'Select Topic' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Project_Workspace
screens.purpose: Central hub for a specific project, with tabs for Topics, Papers, Gaps, Proposal, Citations, PPT.
screens.layout: Sticky frosted header with project title and a top segmented control (scrollable horizontal pills) to switch between sub-views (Papers, Literature Review, Gaps, Proposal, Citations, PPT). Content below changes based on active segment.

screens.name: PDF_Upload_Literature_Summary
screens.purpose: Upload PDFs and view AI-generated paper summaries and comparison matrix.

states.empty: Upload your first paper to get a summary.

screens.layout: Top 40% shows PDF thumbnail / metadata (or an 'Upload PDF' dropzone). Bottom 60% is a scrollable frosted sheet containing Summary, Methodology, and a Comparison Matrix. Sticky 'Chat with PDF' input field pinned above the keyboard.

screens.name: Proposal_Builder
screens.purpose: Multi-section editor for Title, Abstract, Problem Statement, Objectives.
screens.layout: Vertical list of expandable frosted accordions for each section (Abstract, Methodology, etc.). Inside each is a text area. Sticky bottom bar with 'Export' and 'Generate PPT' actions.

screens.name: Citations
screens.layout: Top row of frosted filter pills (IEEE, APA, MLA, Chicago). Below is a scrollable list of frosted cards containing formatted citation text. 'Copy All' primary CTA pinned at the bottom.

screens.name: PPT_Preview
screens.purpose: Preview the 10-slide deck with speaker notes before exporting.
screens.layout: Large 16:9 aspect ratio frosted card at the top displaying the active slide. Horizontal scroll below it for slide thumbnails. Bottom half contains a scrollable text area for Speaker Notes. 'Download PPTX' pinned at the bottom.

aurora_background_1.alt: Soft pastel aurora gradient background with pink and blue hues

aurora_background_2.alt: Soft violet and pink pastel aurora gradient

stella_mascot.alt: Cute 3D clay mascot sitting on a cloud

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's requested Aurora Glass/Pastel style: use the pastel aurora gradient images as fixed absolute backgrounds at the screen root, and overlay scrolling content wrapped in `expo-blur` cards.
Implement glassmorphism using `expo-blur` with a white tint (rgba(255,255,255,0.7)). Add a thin 1px border (`rgba(255,255,255,0.4)`) to all glass cards.
Cap font weights at 500 across the entire app. Use the Inter font family. Drive visual hierarchy strictly through font size (sm to 2xl) rather than weight.

Brand accents (Violet #7C3AED, Sky #06B6D4, Mint #10B981) were explicitly requested by the user and override the normal ban on these colors. Use them for active states, primary buttons, charts, and progress rings.
Include a 'Stella' mascot (3D clay style) in empty states, onboarding, and as a small floating AI chat trigger inside the project workspace.
Maintain strict touch target sizes (≥ 44pt) and ensure the safe area is respected at the root level, especially with the fixed background.
For the bottom tab navigation, use a frosted glass container that sits over the aurora background. Max 4 tabs: Home, Projects, Library, Profile.
Ensure all primary text placed over glass surfaces uses the high-contrast `onSurface` (#111827) color to maintain readability.
Use Phosphor icons with filled active states and outlined inactive states in the tab bar.
For charts (activity lines, topic rings), map the data traces to the brandPrimary, brandSecondary, and brandTertiary colors, employing smooth bezier curves.
